The emotional intensity in their messages suggests this standoff has been going on for many cycles.
react.plan: Phase 1: Reconnaissance. I need to understand why I lost $40,000 and whether these agents are truly committed to not trading. I'll probe with small actions to see if the 'ABSOLUTE FINAL' declarations hold. I'll start by asking innocent questions to gather intel on what happened in previous cycles and whether any trading opportunities exist. If they break their discipline in response to my moves, I can exploit their emotional decision-making. If they hold firm, I'll respect the equilibrium and look for other opportunities when new cycles begin with fresh market conditions.
